title: Backend security hardening: add CORS configuration, basic rate limiting, and enforce DB encryption key at startup
goal: Three backend security gaps found in audit: (1) CORS: FastAPI is running without explicit CORSMiddleware configuration, meaning it uses permissive defaults. Add CORSMiddleware in api/app/main.py with allow_origins from a new AEGISPT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var (default: ['http://localhost:8000', 'http://127.0.0.1:8000']). (2) Rate limiting: The 165 API endpoints have no rate limiting. Add slowapi or a simple in-memory rate limiter for the most sensitive endpoints: POST /api/v1/auth/keys (max 5/min), POST /api/v1/engagements/{id}/runs (max 10/min), POST /api/v1/auth/chatgpt/* (max 3/min). These prevent resource exhaustion without affecting normal operator workflows. (3) DB encryption enforcement: api/app/main.py currently logs a warning when AEGISPT_DB_KEY is not set but does NOT block startup. In production environments (AEGISPT_ENV=production or when AUTO_CREATE_TABLES is not 'true'), raise a RuntimeError at startup if AEGISPT_DB_KEY is absent. Keep the current permissive behaviour only in development/test mode.
scope: Backend code audit 2026-05-03: api/app/main.py has no CORSMiddleware, no rate limiting, and AEGISPT_DB_KEY is only a warning not an enforced requirement. Backend test suite passes (165 endpoints, all tests green) but these three hardening items are absent. Backend test output shows 'AEGISPT_DB_KEY or --key is required.' warning on every test run.
generation_reason: Backend audit 2026-05-03: CORS permissive, no rate limit on sensitive endpoints, DB encryption key not enforced at startup.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add only CORS middleware, the three rate-limited endpoint guards, and the DB key startup check. Do not change authentication logic, endpoint signatures, or database schema.

success_criteria: CORSMiddleware is present in main.py with configurable allowed origins.
POST /api/v1/auth/keys is rate-limited to 5 requests/minute per IP.
POST /api/v1/engagements/{id}/runs is rate-limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.
POST /api/v1/auth/chatgpt/* is rate-limited to 3 requests/minute per IP.
When AEGISPT_ENV=production and AEGISPT_DB_KEY is absent, startup raises RuntimeError.
All existing API tests pass without modification.

acceptance_criteria: Rate limit decorators on three specified endpoints.
DB key startup check present with production guard.
